item.title: Prédictibilité de la prédiction de la performance des requêtes? Une approche basée sur les valeurs aberrantes multivariées
Can we predict QPP? An approach based on multivariate outliers
item.description: Abstract # Query performance prediction (QPP) aims to forecast the effectiveness of a search engine across a range of queries and documents. While state-of-the-art predictors offer a certain level of precision, their accuracy is not flawless. Prior research has recognized the challenges inherent in QPP but often lacks a thorough qualitative analysis. In this paper, we delve into QPP by examining the factors that influence the predictability of query performance accuracy.
